caption: The drawing features a black cylindrical bonnet with a slightly shiny texture, depicted in three-quarter view, placed toward the upper left of the composition. Attached to the bonnet are two long, wide, black ribbons, one extending outward and curving along the bottom of the drawing, the other partially coiled near the base of the bonnet. Resting near the lower right, there are two smaller, faint pencil sketches of the same bonnet: one shows a top-down view of the bonnet and ribbons, while the other presents a rear view. The background is a plain, uncolored beige or off-white surface.
title: Bonnet
